**NET-TOOLS 0.7.0**: 17 new network tools (168 in total), workflow features for daily use (history, compare mode, report bundle, bulk lookup) and optional sign-in with OpenID Connect.

## New tools

- **IP & addressing**: subnet overlap checker.
- **DNS**: DNS health report (graded A–F), DNS TTL change planner (with calendar export), bulk lookup (DNS, PTR, ASN or port check for up to 100 targets).
- **Connectivity**: latency monitor (smokeping-style, up to `MONITOR_MAX_MINUTES`, default 30).
- **Email**: email deliverability report (graded), TLS-RPT report viewer.
- **BGP**: prefix-list tester (IOS and Junos), BGP community decoder (standard, large, extended).
- **Calculators**: PoE budget, NAT/PAT capacity (incl. RFC 7422 deterministic NAT), wireless link budget (FSPL, Fresnel zone, earth bulge), DSCP / ToS converter, config diff, ACL analyzer (shadowed and redundant rules, packet trace).
- **Client**: provider status (which API keys are set, provider errors), report bundle.

## Improvements

- **History**: recent inputs appear as chips under each tool and can be pinned. They're stored in your browser.
- **Compare mode**: open any tool twice side by side, for example two resolvers or a before/after check. The URL can be shared.
- **Add to report**: every result table can be added to one report, exported as Markdown, JSON or print/PDF.
- **Rate-limit feedback**: errors count down until you can retry, and tool pages warn when only a few heavy requests are left. Streaming tools now show the real rate-limit error instead of "connection lost".
- **Speed test**: bufferbloat grade (latency under load).

## Optional sign-in (OIDC)

Off by default; nothing changes unless you set `AUTH_MODE=oidc`.
- **Providers**: works with Keycloak, Authentik, Entra ID, Google, Authelia and any other OpenID Connect provider.
- **Roles**: a user and an admin role, taken from your identity provider's groups. Admin-only tools are set with `AUTH_ADMIN_TOOLS`.
- **Visitors who don't sign in**: you choose whether they only get the browser tools or all non-admin tools (`AUTH_ANONYMOUS_ROLE`).
- **Session**: a signed cookie, so there's no database.

Setup is in the README section "Sign-in (optional)"; the security design is in `docs/SECURITY.md` §7.

## Reverse proxy network

New optional `docker-compose.proxy.yml`: connects the web container to an existing reverse-proxy network (Traefik, Caddy, Nginx Proxy Manager), so the proxy reaches it as `http://nettools:8080` without publishing a port. See the README.

## Upgrade

```bash
cd net-tools-docker
git pull
docker compose pull && docker compose up -d
```

No configuration changes are required. If `NETTOOLS_VERSION` is pinned in `.env`, set it to `0.7.0`.

Images: `ghcr.io/digibaro/nettools-web:0.7.0`, `ghcr.io/digibaro/nettools-api:0.7.0` (amd64 + arm64, SBOM and provenance). Full list: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/digibaro/net-tools-docker/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## Notes

- In the `public` profile without sign-in, the provider status page is visible to everyone. It shows which API keys are set (never the keys) and usage counts.
- Not yet included: SNMP switch MAC/ARP table and LLDP topology via SNMP, browser TLS fingerprint, UDP service probe, IPsec/IKE probe.
